channel.title: 3ABN Today
channel.desc: Join us for a special anniversary interview as 3ABN welcomes FARM STEW International to celebrate 10 incredible years of ministry and mission! Discover how this faith-based organization has been transforming lives around the world through practical training in Farming, Attitude, Rest, Meals, Sanitation, Temperance, Enterprise, and Water. Hear inspiring testimonies, and powerful insights from FARM STEW as they reflect on a decade of service guided by the gospel and compassion.
